mira: After last night's maintenance, staging shows ~600 leases renewed but not attached. Spike ~01:40 UTC.
ben: mount paths?
mira: secret/data/services/* and secret/data/partners/*, sample lease=lease-4c7d9a, owner=svc-infer-worker@redwood, ttl=86400.
dalia: did the KMS rewrap run? any key rotations?
luis_ops: we rotated staging infer-wrap -> v6 during the window. some rewrap tasks failed. I9ll own coordination.
sec-bot: created INC-2026-0717, severity=medium, owner=luis_ops.
ben: I queried audit to find principals: svc-infer-worker (430), svc-cache (95), svc-partner-sync (55).
dalia: renews show many ttl=86400, likely long-lived tokens not revoked on scale-down.
mira: hypothesis: autoscaler killed workers without revoke hook; rewrap errors meant renews persisted.
luis_ops: containment plan: snapshot leases to GCS, mark affected mounts read-only, staged lease revocations, run KMS rewrap for failed ciphertexts, provide fallback short-lived creds for impacted services.
ben: will run dry-run revokes then small live batches (<=50). create decrypt-error alert threshold.
sre-oncall: alert AP-179123 set for decrypt-errors >3 in 5m.
dalia: will run idempotent rewrap job to key v6 with retries.
mira: snapshot cmd: `vault list -format=json sys/leases/lookup | jq . > /tmp/leases-179123.json && gsutil cp /tmp/leases-179123.json gs://infra-dumps/inc-179123/`.
ben: batch-1 revoke (25 ids) done. saw 2 svc-cache errors, created temporary fallback token with 2h TTL at secret/fallback/cache-svc.
dalia: rewrap job progressed 100/240; fixed multi-step rewraps for legacy ciphertexts.
luis_ops: recommendation post-incident: enforce max renew TTL=12h for non-critical roles and require revoke on shutdown. I'll open RFC.
ben: final revoke batches complete, decrypt errors returned to baseline after fallbacks expired.
mira: will paste lease snapshot and revoke logs into INC-2026-0717.
sec-bot: INC-2026-0717 resolved by luis_ops at 1791234940
